description.en: Substance Registry Services (SRS) is the Environmental Protection Agency's (EPA) central system for information about substances that are tracked or regulated by EPA or other sources. It is the authoritative resource for basic information about chemicals, biological organisms, and other substances of interest to EPA and its state and tribal partners.

other_download.title: EPA Linked Data Services
other_download.description: Platform for accessing all EPA Linked Data sets using query tools, services, applications, URI resolution, mapping and more.

other_download.title: SRS Schema
other_download.description: RDF schema in TTL format describing the classes and predicates in the data.

other_download.title: VoID description
other_download.description: VoID is an RDF Schema vocabulary for expressing metadata about RDF datasets
